scientifically_necessary: real watch photographs rather than synthetic images, diagrams, or movement-only parts
no thumbnail, resized preview, screenshot, or .rf. augmentation substitute
five training brands excluded from the OOD set
no hash, URL, or near-duplicate overlap with Phase 16, Phase 35, Phase 36, or the locked final test
holdout images are not used for threshold search
a source family stays in one split
holdout floors of 60 unseen luxury, 40 ordinary, and 25 smart/digital
at least 4 unseen brands with at least 8 holdout images and no brand above 40 percent of the unseen holdout
the evaluated model is not the brand verifier
highly_desirable: more than one website and more than one photographer
potentially_over_restrictive: Commons category as the only allowed brand declaration

A_licensed_open_images.evidence: Commons ceiling after the brand cap is about 216 unseen, 149 ordinary, 104 smart, and 14 wrist. Other open pilots failed brand verification, the byte cap, or original-byte delivery.

B_newly_captured.realistic_scale: Low tens of photographs from watches a researcher owns or can borrow with permission. No collaborator or store program is on record.

D_existing_datasets.evidence: Roboflow exports are .rf. derivatives. Timepiecepedia image licenses are unknown. The local archive has no license. A Hugging Face wristwatch search returned 0 datasets.

brand_verification.expert_manual: acceptable only in a future versioned protocol with a written record
brand_verification.multi_source: acceptable when the records agree about the photograph, not merely about a catalog row
brand_verification.model_assisted: not allowed for the model under evaluation; no second oracle was justified

proposed_changes_not_adopted.change: Raise or remove the 1.5 MB cap and keep the no-resize rule
proposed_changes_not_adopted.scientific_justification: The cap discarded originals without measuring independence.
proposed_changes_not_adopted.comparability: Phase 36 stays frozen. A later corpus would be a new experiment.
proposed_changes_not_adopted.expected_evidence_quality: Higher only if a licensed supply of large originals exists. That supply was not shown.

proposed_changes_not_adopted.change: Allow a documented expert brand check in addition to a source-declared brand
proposed_changes_not_adopted.scientific_justification: A publisher category is one kind of label evidence. It is not the only kind.
proposed_changes_not_adopted.legal_implication: Does not create an image license.
proposed_changes_not_adopted.comparability: Brand rates would need a verification_method field.
proposed_changes_not_adopted.expected_evidence_quality: Could admit licensed photos that currently fail as UNKNOWN brand. It does not create the missing photographs.
